seo.title: Crowns & Bridges in Noida | Ranco Dental
seo.description: Durable, tooth-coloured crowns and bridges in Noida Sector 141 at Ranco Dental. Restore damaged or missing teeth with a natural-looking, long-lasting fit.

overview: A dental crown is a cap placed over a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its shape, strength and appearance, while a bridge replaces one or more missing teeth by anchoring a false tooth to the crowns on either side of the gap. Both are custom-made to match the colour and shape of your natural teeth.
overviewImageAlt: Dental crowns and a bridge on a model of the gums
reasons: A cracked, chipped or severely worn-down tooth
A large filling that no longer supports the tooth
One or more missing teeth affecting your bite
A tooth after root canal treatment that needs protection
Wanting to improve the shape or colour of a tooth

procedure.title: Consultation and Examination
procedure.description: We examine your teeth and take X-rays to check if a crown or bridge is the right solution for you.

procedure.title: Tooth Preparation
procedure.description: The affected tooth is gently reshaped to make room for the crown, and impressions are taken.

procedure.title: Temporary Crown Placement
procedure.description: A temporary crown is fitted to protect your tooth while your custom restoration is prepared.

procedure.title: Final Crown or Bridge Fitting
procedure.description: Your permanent crown or bridge is checked for fit and colour match, then permanently cemented into place.

whyChooseUs: Focus on patient comfort and care
Transparent pricing and flexible appointment scheduling

faqs.question: Is getting a crown or bridge painful?
faqs.answer: No, the area is numbed with local anesthesia before your tooth is prepared, so the procedure itself is painless. You may feel mild sensitivity for a day or two afterward.

faqs.question: How many visits does it take?
faqs.answer: Most crowns and bridges take two visits: one to prepare the tooth and fit a temporary crown, and a second to fit the permanent restoration once it's ready.

faqs.question: How long do crowns and bridges last?
faqs.answer: With good oral hygiene and regular checkups, crowns and bridges typically last 10 to 15 years or longer.

faqs.question: Can I eat normally with a crown or bridge?
faqs.answer: Yes, once your permanent restoration is fitted you can eat normally. We recommend avoiding very hard or sticky foods with your temporary crown.

faqs.question: Will my crown or bridge look natural?
faqs.answer: Yes, crowns and bridges are custom-made to match the colour, size and shape of your surrounding teeth for a natural-looking result.
